name: Link Peek
description: A link that shows a small card with a picture, title and host when hovered or focused.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the link goes. Its host is shown at the foot of the card.

props.name: children
props.description: The link text. It carries the meaning; the card is hidden from assistive technology. Keep it to a short phrase, as it does not wrap.

props.name: preview
props.type: { image: string; title: string; description?: string }
props.description: What the card shows. Nothing is fetched; pass the picture yourself, as a URL or data URI shown at 16:10.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the card in pixels. The card stays at least 8 pixels inside the window.

props.name: side
props.description: Whether the card appears above or below the link.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds of hover before the card shows. Keyboard focus shows it at once and Escape hides it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the link. Other props go to the a element.
